pages.text: 250 HP, immune to knockback. Punches, a $(l)shockwave$(), and below half health a $(l)rage$(): faster, it makes crystal fangs erupt toward you. Drops the $(item)Sentinel Core$() and lots of Onyx.

$(li)$(l)Leap$(): jumps on distant players and slams on landing.$(li)$(l)Crystal rain$(): glittering circles appear under players, crystal fangs burst out 2 seconds later. Move!$(li)$(l)Onyx shell$() (rage): arms crossed, takes 75% less damage for 4 s. Wait it out.$(li)Below 25%: calls Onyx Cubes.
